_source: Five Parsecs: Tactics p.167 (Krag profiles and Special Rules). Units are composed from data/tactics/army_builder.json (pp.133-139); weapons come from data/tactics/tactics_weapons_master.json (p.181)

species.description: Stocky, resilient beings known for their stubbornness and durability. Krag forces are hard to break in close combat.

traits.name: Rivalry
traits.description: Individuals shooting at or making a close assault on an enemy individual unit may add +1 to all attack rolls.

rules_text.Rivalry: Individuals shooting at or making a close assault on an enemy individual unit may add +1 to all attack rolls.
